Maya: Quick follow-up from yesterday's DR game-day. Capturing remediation owners/timelines for the items we surfaced. I'll seed owners — edit if wrong.

Maya: Items:
1) Restore runbook clarity (A-101) — owner: Carlos — ETA: 2026-04-07 — Deliverable: step-by-step restore checklist + playbook tests
2) Cross-region routing map (A-102) — owner: Zara — ETA: 2026-04-09 — Deliverable: routing map + fallback policies
3) Snapshot verification & retention (A-103) — owner: Liam — ETA: 2026-04-05 — Deliverable: automated verify job + perf regression gating
4) DNS TTL policy for critical records (A-104) — owner: Carlos — ETA: 2026-04-03 — Deliverable: infra PR + runbook step
5) Periodic game-day cadence (A-105) — owner: Maya — ETA: 2026-05-01 — Deliverable: quarterly schedule + runbook dry run

Carlos: ack — will draft restore checklist and include the "partial restore" flow. I'll add a short test matrix.

Liam: taking snapshots verification. Plan: run nightly verify job against staging restores, failure -> pager. ETA EOW.

Zara: routing map — need list of region endpoints + traffic weights. @Maya can you paste the list of critical VIPs?

Maya: pasted below (from infra):
- vip-api.redwood-prod (primary:us-west1, secondary:eu-west1)
- vip-embed.redwood-prod (primary:us-east1, secondary:asia-east1)

Maya: minimal restore checklist snippet (put into runbook):
```
1. Validate snapshot ID & region
2. Provision test VMs in target region
3. Attach snapshot -> start DB upgrade lock
4. Smoke test ingest and embeddings
5. Promote endpoint and warm caches
6. Flip traffic to promoted region
```

Zara: +1 to smoke tests. Also propose adding a "traffic drain window" step (pre-cutover) for 90s to let KV caches flush.

Carlos: FYI recurring pattern: regional failovers are often slowed by long DNS TTLs + stale cache on CDN. I'll add tests for CDN cache purge during game days. (A-104 depends on this).

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: A-101 (Carlos) due 2026-04-07. Please update status in the tracker: https://go/rw-dr-tracker

Maya: OK team — I'll create the tracker rows and invite owners to a 30m sync tomorrow. If anyone needs to reprioritize, reply here.

Liam: Can we triage "snapshot verify flakiness" as high priority? I saw failures ~3% last week in staging restores.

Maya: Marking A-103 High. Liam, add flaky cases and I'll escalate infra quota for extra retention if needed.

Carlos: Added initial PR template to the tracker. Will link restore checklist PR once ready.

Zara: I'll drop routing map draft by Friday. :spiral_calendar:

Maya: Thanks all. Closing thread — follow-ups tracked in tracker. :thumbsup:
